description: The Australian Bureau of Meteorology publishes EWER through NCI Australia to bring together water-level observations from estuaries, bays and open-coast gauges. The catalogue identifies 724 unique sites and 12,072 equivalent years of non-flagged observations. Its temporal envelope is 1897 to December 2025, with individual gauge records covering different periods; some sites are in the Pacific and Antarctica. CSV data are available through the public NCI THREDDS catalogue, free under CC-BY-4.0. The article documents hourly values and flags for possible datum shifts, outliers, spikes and river influence. Flagged observations may represent valid floods and should not be discarded automatically. Incomplete datum connections and uneven site coverage create uncertainty for engineering flood levels and long-term trends. The series can calibrate estuary and compound-flood simulations for ports and coastal settlements. EWER complements GESLA by retaining shorter and more river-influenced records. No observations were downloaded.
